skill.name: zach-seller-skill-creator
skill.description: Guides Amazon sellers through a Chinese-first process for turning repeatable business workflows into reusable AI skills. It collects six business answers, drafts SKILL.md content, creates evaluation prompts, runs benchmarks, and supports review-driven iteration.
skill.summary: Create reusable AI skills from Amazon seller workflows with guided questions, tests, benchmarks, and review loops.
skill.author: zach22-1999

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, Chinese-language text entropy, CSS names, and documentation examples. Confirmed risks are operational rather than clearly malicious: local subprocess execution, inherited environment variables, temporary HTML review files, third-party web assets, packaging archives, and two viewer HTML insertion points. No evidence found of auditor-targeting prompt injection or covert data exfiltration instructions in the reviewed skill files.

remediation.issue: Viewer HTML insertion points can render generated workspace data.
remediation.suggestion: Avoid innerHTML for workbook and benchmark rendering, or sanitize generated markup with a strict allowlist before insertion.

remediation.issue: Evaluation scripts launch local subprocesses and inherit most environment variables.
remediation.suggestion: Pass a minimal environment to child processes, document required variables, and require explicit user confirmation before running Claude CLI evaluations.

remediation.issue: The review server kills processes by port before binding.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer selecting a free port or asking before terminating an existing process, and show the target PID before any kill action.

remediation.issue: The packager can include unintended local files.
remediation.suggestion: Add default exclusions for secrets and local data such as .env, key files, feedback dumps, transcripts, and private examples; print a manifest for review before writing the archive.

remediation.issue: Optional optimization sends skill content and eval data to external model services.
remediation.suggestion: Document the external API use clearly and ask users to remove confidential seller data before running description optimization.

remediation.issue: Generated HTML depends on external font and script CDNs.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle static assets locally or document the network dependency; keep SRI on third-party scripts if CDN loading remains.

这是一个**中文版**的 skill 创建器,基于 Anthropic 官方 `skill-creator` 重构,针对亚马逊卖家(AI 基础较弱但有丰富业务经验的用户)优化。
官方 `skill-creator` 上来就问"这个 skill 要做什么"。卖家用户经常给出空洞的答案(比如"帮我做关键词分析"),导致产出的 skill 只是一份说明书、没有业务深度。
阶段 0 的正式执行脚本在 `references/6问引导式流程.md`。先读它,再开始问。**不要**把 `references/6问模板.md` 当成用户填写入口发出去。
- 必须顺序走 `Q1 → Q6`,一个主题走完再进入下一个
| Q1 业务目标 | `## 业务背景` 段(解释 why) |
| Q2 现有做法 | `## 当前工作流(人工版)` 段(基线对照) |
| Q3 具体步骤 | `## Skill 工作流(自动版)` 段(主干指令,转成编号步骤) |
| Q4 方法论 | `## 核心原则 / 踩坑规避` 段(对应官方的 principles 概念) |
| Q5 调用方式 | YAML `description` 字段 + `## 触发场景` 段 |
| Q6 期望输出 | `## 输出规范` 段 |
**例外**:用户明确说“我就想快速试试,先不管那么多”时,可以降级为只走 `Q1 + Q3 + Q6` 三个核心主题,但要明确告诉他:这样产出的 skill 更容易空、后面如果结果不满意需要回来补齐

semantic_findings.title: External API Submission of Skill Content
semantic_findings.description: The description optimizer sends the current description, eval failures, and full skill content to the Anthropic API. It can also log transcripts that include prompts, model thinking, and parsed descriptions, so proprietary workflow data needs explicit user consent.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code constructs a prompt containing skill content and eval results, calls client.messages.create, and optionally writes transcripts to disk. This is expected optimization behavior, but it is a clear privacy and data-handling risk.

semantic_findings.title: Skill Package May Include Unintended Files
semantic_findings.description: The packager recursively archives files from the selected skill folder while excluding only a small set of build artifacts. Files such as .env, credentials, private customer examples, or local notes could be bundled unless users inspect the folder first.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exclusion list is narrow and the archive loop writes every non-excluded file under the selected skill directory. This creates a plausible accidental disclosure path during packaging.

content.user_title: Create Seller Skills With Guided Evaluations
content.value_statement: Amazon sellers often describe repeatable workflows too broadly for reusable AI skills. This skill turns those workflows into structured SKILL.md drafts, tests, benchmarks, and review loops.
actual_capabilities: Guides users through six required business questions before writing a skill.
Maps business answers into SKILL.md sections and trigger descriptions.
Creates realistic evaluation prompts for new or improved skills.
Runs with-skill and baseline evaluation workflows when local tools are available.
Generates benchmark summaries and HTML review pages for user feedback.
Packages a completed skill into a distributable .skill archive.
limitations: The main workflow is Chinese-first and may need translation for English-only teams.
Benchmark and description optimization features require local command execution.
Description optimization depends on Claude CLI access and an Anthropic API key.
The skill does not replace manual review of generated instructions or packaged files.

use_cases.title: Turn Seller Operations Into Skills
use_cases.description: Convert repeated listing, keyword, advertising, or review workflows into reusable AI skill instructions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Playbooks
use_cases.description: Capture team methods, edge cases, and expected outputs before sharing a workflow skill with other staff.

use_cases.title: Test Skill Quality Before Release
use_cases.description: Compare skill-assisted outputs with baseline outputs and collect user feedback before packaging a skill.

prompt_templates.title: Start a New Seller Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a skill for my Amazon seller workflow. Guide me through the six business questions before writing any draft.

prompt_templates.title: Convert an Existing Process
prompt_templates.prompt: I already have a repeatable Amazon operations process. Help me turn it into a SKILL.md with trigger rules and output requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Add Evaluation Cases
prompt_templates.prompt: Create two or three realistic evaluation prompts for this skill, then explain what each prompt should prove.

prompt_templates.title: Run the Full Improvement Loop
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the with-skill versus baseline evaluation loop, generate a review page, read my feedback, and improve the skill until it is ready to package.

output_examples.input: I want a skill that checks whether a listing has review-risk opportunities.
output: A SKILL.md outline with business background, workflow steps, rules, trigger scenarios, and output format.
A short set of realistic evaluation prompts for review before testing.

output_examples.input: Improve my current keyword report skill and prove it is better.
output: A test plan with with-skill and baseline runs.
A benchmark summary that compares pass rate, time, and token use.
A review workflow for collecting feedback and applying targeted changes.

output_examples.input: Package this finished skill for my team.
output_examples.output: A validated .skill archive path, plus a reminder to inspect packaged files before sharing.

best_practices: Answer the six business questions with real examples, thresholds, and exception rules.
Review every generated evaluation prompt before running benchmark scripts.
Inspect generated HTML, benchmark output, and packaged files before sharing them.
anti_patterns: Do not skip the business questions when the workflow is still vague.
Do not treat benchmark scores as final without reading representative outputs.
Do not package folders that may contain credentials, private data, or unrelated files.

faq.question: Who is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for Amazon sellers and operators who want to turn repeatable work into reusable AI skills.

faq.question: Does it require coding knowledge?
faq.answer: Basic use does not require coding knowledge. Benchmarking and packaging require an environment that can run local commands.

faq.question: Why does it ask six questions first?
faq.answer: The six questions collect goals, current process, rules, triggers, and outputs before the skill draft is written.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare an old version with a revised version, collect feedback, and guide iteration.

faq.question: Does it send data to external services?
faq.answer: Some optional optimization scripts use Claude or the Anthropic API. Review sensitive workflow data before running those scripts.

faq.question: Is the packaged skill ready to publish automatically?
